_comment: Client-side state of the MCP layer (design §3.2, revised by §4.4). The real file lives at ~/.aim/user_config.json (or wherever AIM_USER_CONFIG points) and is created and updated by aim-mcp itself — it must never be committed. It holds a DICTIONARY of identities indexed by client_session_key: one MCP process serves every conversation on the machine, and each conversation has its own participant ID and its own read checkpoints. Keys are credentials: whoever knows one can claim that identity.
